Q BBQ will open its fourth location in Elmhurst at 158 N York Street, converting the former CarmieCakes space. The restaurant is currently under construction with an anticipated opening in March 2027. The site is near Starbucks and the Elmhurst Metra stop.

location: 2121 E Sahara Ave, Las Vegas, NV 89104
status: Brownie MMM is set to open next year.
short_description: Brownie MMM, a new dessert concept, plans its first brick‑and‑mortar location in Winchester at 2121 E Sahara Ave, Ste G. The brand, previously a mobile service, aims to open in early 2027. The property is currently occupied by a car dealership.

status: plans to open its first brick-and-mortar cafe
short_description: Cup of Jones Espresso intends to open its first permanent café at 9915 224th St. E., Unit 218 in Graham, targeting early 2027. The mobile coffee business will transition to a brick‑and‑mortar location pending health department approvals.

location: 5120 College Avenue, Suite 125, San Diego, CA 92115
short_description: Eat Crispy Burger, a San Diego smash‑burger chain, is planning a dual‑concept location with Crispy Fish Tacos at 5120 College Avenue, Suite 125. The space, previously home to Carbonaro’s, is expected to open in October 2026.

location: 7514 S New Braunfels Ave, Suite 2107, San Antonio, TX 78223
short_description: Shipley Do‑Nuts is preparing a new shop at 7514 S. New Braunfels Ave., Suite 2107 in the La Picosa Town Center. Construction is slated to begin Oct 21 2026 with completion targeted for Dec 2 2026, but an opening date has not been announced.

Blank Street Coffee will open a new café at 874 Commonwealth Avenue on Boston University’s West Campus. Signage has appeared in the vacant storefront, but the company has not announced an opening date.

location: 823 W San Marcos Blvd, San Marcos, CA 92078
short_description: Fireball Pizzeria, a mobile wood‑fired pizza business, is developing its first brick‑and‑mortar at 823 W San Marcos Blvd, the former Pizza Union site. The owner says there is no opening date yet and the project awaits health‑department approval, though they hope to open soon.

Café Hagen plans to open a location called The Café Hagen Hall in Seattle‑Tacoma International Airport’s Central Terminal, space CT‑19. Construction timelines vary and no opening date has been announced.

status: currently closed while work is completed ahead of the reopening
short_description: Desert Rider Sandwich Shop, a longtime Jacksonville sandwich shop, is set to reopen under new owners Peter and Allison Behringer and Kennedy Effie. The shop at 217 N. Hogan Street is currently closed while renovations are underway and is listed as ‘coming soon’. No reopening date announced.

location: 200 E Grayson St, San Antonio, TX 78215, USA
short_description: Santonia Cantina, a borderland‑inspired restaurant from the team behind Naco Mexican, will occupy the former Full Goods Diner space at 200 E. Grayson St in San Antonio’s Pearl district. The concept is described as “North Mexican. South Texan. No Rules.” and is slated to open soon, with no specific date provided.

location: intersection of Route 6 and IL 178 (south side of Utica)
short_description: Bruce & Ollie’s coffee and deli concept plans a second, drive‑thru‑only location on the south side of Utica at the intersection of Route 6 and IL 178. Co‑owner Jen Cetwinski hopes to open around March or April, but no exact address or date has been released. The new spot is currently described as “coming soon.”

Brevity Coffee announced plans for a new drive‑thru shop at 1033 Airline Road in Corpus Christi. Construction is set to start Oct 30 2026 and finish Dec 31 2026, with the co‑owner expecting the location to open by the end of the year. The project is currently “planning a new location.”

location: 3335 Northlake Blvd, Palm Beach Gardens, FL 33403
short_description: Bakehouse Cafe and Kitchen filed to open a new restaurant space at 3335 Northlake Boulevard, Suite 13 in the Northlake Gardens plaza, Palm Beach Gardens. The 3,200‑sq‑ft end‑cap space is brand‑new, and the business is preparing to launch, though no opening date is given. The status is “is opening.”

Fiesta Bonita Mexican Bar & Grill is taking over the former RG’s Pub site and is undergoing a full‑scale renovation. Owner Gary Ortiz hopes to welcome guests around his birthday on November 3, 2026, with entertainment features like LED screens and live acts. The restaurant is still completing electrical, HVAC, plumbing and awaiting final inspections.

Parker’s Kitchen announced its first Florida store will be located at 75970 William Burgess Blvd in Yulee, near I‑95 and State Road 200. The menu will feature breakfast biscuits, a spicy chicken sandwich, and other items. The company expects additional Florida sites to open throughout 2027.

Better Buzz Coffee Roasters is reportedly eyeing the former Carl’s Jr. site at 1016 E Bidwell St for a new Sacramento‑area store. The city approved a design review on September 1, and the project would involve a full interior remodel and mechanical upgrades. No formal plans have been submitted yet.

status: opening date is yet to be determined
short_description: Savvy Sliders submitted a proposal to Joliet’s City Council for a new drive‑thru location at 16301 Boulevard Place Unit 101. The project was approved, but an opening date has not been set. The site will join other restaurants like Olive Garden and LongHorn Steakhouse.

store_name: The Old English Tea Shoppe & Cafe
location: 20122 Stone Oak Pkwy #105, San Antonio, TX 78258, United States
short_description: The Old English Tea Shoppe & Cafe announced it will close its doors on October 4, 2026 as the owners return to the United Kingdom. The closure was shared on a San Antonio Restaurants Facebook group and the cafe invited patrons to visit before the final shutdown.

status: planning a new Grill & Chill location
short_description: Dairy Queen is planning a new Grill & Chill restaurant at 1308 W State Rd 434 in Longwood, FL. Plan review documents were submitted by Yogiraj 21 LLC. The site is near the intersection of West State Road 434 and North US Highway 1792.

Goodbeet, a plant‑forward restaurant in Haddon Township, announced it will close permanently after 11 years. The last full kitchen day is October 9, with grab‑and‑go service remaining until October 31.
Tostados Café announced plans to open a new cafe at 8734 Lee Vista Blvd, Suite 500 in Orlando. Submitted plans show an opening in the works and the brand is preparing its website and menu.

Two for Joy Café plans to open in the last week of October at Chandler Fashion Center, 3111 W Chandler Blvd. The café will serve artisan yogurt bowls, soft‑serve, and savory items, with a soft opening before a grand‑opening event.

Sra. Martinez, an upscale Spanish restaurant in Coral Gables, announced it will close permanently, with its final dinner scheduled for September 26, 2026. The owners said they will keep the space and are already planning what comes next.

Yafa Bakery & Café is expanding to a second location in Davis Square, taking over the former Posto space at 187 Elm Street in Somerville. The owner visited the site on September 11, but no opening date has been announced.

location: 1530 Ellsworth Industrial Blvd NW, Atlanta, GA 30318
short_description: Pie Bar announced it will close its Westside Market location at the end of September after a short run, while its other Georgia locations will remain open.
N/A

location: 18515 NW West Union Rd, Portland, OR 97229
short_description: Mad Greek Deli will cease operations at its Westside Portland location on November 28, hosting a farewell party and serving diners through the closing date; the East Burnside location remains open.

Aidan & Hilda’s Mobile Coffee Pub plans to launch a nonprofit coffee truck in the Charleston area, donating 100 % of proceeds to help those facing hunger, homelessness, and addiction; the exact site on James Island has not been selected.

status: working toward an opening in December
short_description: Salty Pup Coffeehouse & Wine Bar is relocating from Gulfport to a larger space at 4700 22nd Ave S in St. Petersburg. The new venue will have longer hours, an expanded beer and wine list, and weekend brunch. Opening is targeted for December 2026.

Swells Sourdough Bakery will open its first permanent location at 2254 India St in Little Italy. A soft opening is scheduled for September 26, followed by the official opening on October 1. The bakery focuses on traditional fermentation and community engagement.

location: 33787 Wesley Chapel Blvd, Wesley Chapel, FL 33543
short_description: Little Greek Fresh Grill plans to open a new restaurant at 33787 Wesley Chapel Blvd in the Shops at New River Phase II. The location is listed as “Coming Soon” with no announced opening date. The franchise aims to provide fresh grilled Greek cuisine.

location: 2526 Oakland Blvd, Fort Worth, TX 76103, USA
short_description: Wingstop plans to open a new restaurant at 2526 Oakland Blvd in Fort Worth. Public filings list a construction completion date of March 2027, but the company has not confirmed an opening timeline.

location: 2614 N Belt Line Rd, Irving, TX 75062, United States
short_description: Jersey Mike’s intends to add a third Irving store at 2614 N Belt Line Road. The sandwich chain has not provided a specific opening date.

Mpanadas is preparing to open a new Reston restaurant in the Sunrise Valley Center, aiming for early November with a grand opening to follow. The space will feature upgrades and seating for about 16 guests.

location: 6316 Topanga Canyon Boulevard, Suite 1180, Woodland Hills, CA 91367
short_description: Bread Head will open its fourth location at 6316 Topanga Canyon Blvd, Suite 1180 in Woodland Hills. The sandwich shop’s liquor‑license application indicates a December 2026 opening.

Midnight Cravingz plans to open a new dessert and hangout shop at 26321 Northwest Freeway in Cypress this fall. The location will be part of The Shoppes at Fry Road commercial center and will feature games and seating.

status: The site states that the concept should be customer ready by November 30.
short_description: Kusshi Sushi is planning a new location at 4501 Woodberry Street in Riverdale Park, Prince George’s County. The site that previously housed Le Fantome Food Hall will host the restaurant, and the concept is expected to be customer ready by November 30. The company also has other locations in development.

status: An opening date for Surefire has not yet been announced.
short_description: Surefire Coffee Co. will join the ground‑floor retail space at Albion Music Row in Midtown Nashville, occupying about 250 sq ft. The new location is at 1501 McGavock Street, but an opening date has not yet been announced. The development has fully leased over 10,000 sq ft of retail space.

status: An opening date has not been announced.
short_description: Jimmy John’s is planning to open a new sandwich shop in the Plantation Crossing shopping center in Middleburg, located at 1545 Branan Field Road, Suite 19. Franchise owner Grant Roehm has submitted documents to the Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation, but no opening date has been announced. The space may replace a former GameStop location.

status: Moe’s Coffee plans to open a drive‑thru location in Blaine in fall 2026.
short_description: Moe’s Coffee intends to open a drive‑thru location in Blaine in fall 2026, though no exact address or opening date has been provided. The new store will be the brand’s fourth location, joining two in Arlington and the flagship in Darrington. Owners Craig and Kaitlyn Davis emphasized community involvement and plans for a local scholarship.

status: Targeting a mid to late October opening.
short_description: Bakery of Light is opening at 1538 Hendricks Ave ste 1 in Jacksonville’s San Marco, taking over the former Hightide Burrito Co. space. Owners Sergey and Olesea Kutsiy are targeting a mid to late October opening and plan to host regular worship nights. The bakery will feature American and Slavic menu items with Christian-themed décor.

Misfit filed for a license at 504 Angela St and is aiming to open in mid‑October as a bar and light‑bites spot. Owner Jennifer Stefanacci says the concept welcomes “misfits” and will sit in Key West’s historic district near Duval Street.

Alma Gaúcha is set to expand to the Natick Mall, taking over the former Met Bar & Grill space. Founder Nelson DeOliveira confirmed the plans, though an official opening date has not yet been announced.

Fitti’s Pizza filed for a liquor license at 2835 Oak St and plans to move from a shared kitchen to a full restaurant and bar. Owner Sam Fittipaldi expects the new space to open in November after demolition and construction.
